status: G-generic-preflight implemented and verified; R/E remain separate
title: Layered repeated-measurement history generator preflight
scientific_correction: There is no single source-matched generator that simultaneously reproduces Lyons-Brown D(S3) local circuit noise and supplies noisy D4 intrinsic-herald labels. The former is a source-reproduction layer; the latter is a project extension beyond Jing et al.'s perfect-measurement D4 analysis.

layers.scope: Lyons-Brown local circuit faults, repeated D(S3)/D(Z3) stabilizer measurements, syndrome detectors, gauging-boundary consistency, and computational-anyon motion
layers.forbidden_claim: No noisy D4 herald label may be attributed to this source layer without a derived translation.

layers.scope: Independent binary edge-data faults, binary syndrome-readout flips, and a categorical herald confusion channel on supplied truth trajectories
layers.forbidden_claim: This phenomenological layer is not the Lyons-Brown circuit model and is not a physical D4 reproduction.

layers.scope: A future derived D4 spacetime channel connecting repeated fusion-remnant labels to the validated Lab 004 observation-only spatial decoder
layers.status: blocked on generic schema and D4 spacetime derivation
layers.forbidden_claim: Jing et al.'s perfect-measurement threshold results cannot be reused as noisy-herald evidence.

generic_registered_model.data_faults: independent Bernoulli edge flips between adjacent readout rounds with rate p_data, propagated through a supplied binary check-edge incidence matrix
generic_registered_model.syndrome_readout: independent Bernoulli check-readout flips with rate p_syndrome
generic_registered_model.random_streams: one explicit master seed expanded into distinct deterministic data, syndrome, and herald substreams
generic_registered_model.matched_history: sample one complete history per trial and pass the same immutable result/digest to every schedule branch

acceptance_tests: every confusion-matrix row is nonnegative and sums to one throughout the registered parameter domain
p_fp changes only none-to-labelled observations; p_fn changes only labelled-to-none observations; p_confuse changes only blue/green label identity
p_data=0 and p_syndrome=0 recover the supplied truth trajectory and detector identity
one syndrome-readout fault creates the expected adjacent-time detector pair
separate seeded substreams make channel replay bit identical and prevent one parameter from perturbing unrelated sampled masks
causal prefixes expose no future readouts and no truth/fault sidecars
all four scheduling branches bind to the same generated-history digest
categorical herald truth/readout is preserved without silently coercing label confusion to a Boolean field

verification.data_status: no pilot samples or logical-performance data produced

claim_boundary: The next implementation is a generic probability/schema preflight only. It will not reproduce D(S3) circuit noise, derive a D4 spacetime herald channel, generate logical-performance evidence, or establish a threshold or fault tolerance.
next_gate: Use the registered research workflow to define the smallest prerequisite matrix for R-ds3-source and E-d4-herald-extension. Keep the branches distinct and do not launch a performance pilot until one branch supplies physical correction and logical-scoring semantics.
